nodes.title: How to use
widgets_values:
## Finnish text from Poro 2 8B

1. Write the request in **prompt**, in Finnish, and the assistant's role in **System prompt**.
2. Run. The answer appears in **Text**.

Write the prompts in Finnish: Poro's Finnish is clearly worse when it is asked in English. It knows
Finnish and English only; for other languages use *Text Generation (Gemma 4 12B)*. Turn
**keep_model_loaded** on when running several prompts in a row: loading takes about 1.5 minutes, writing
about 8 tokens a second.

nodes.title: About this workflow
widgets_values:
## About this workflow

LumiOpen's Poro 2 8B Instruct, Llama 3.1 8B trained further on Finnish and English (Llama 3.3 Community
Licence), run through transformers by the template pack's Generate Text (Transformers) node. The model is
a folder in `models/LLM/`. In tests it wrote correct Finnish where Gemma 4 12B made mistakes in every
text.

Asset profile: `poro-2-8b`.
